query:
-- Liaisons multiples terpènes majeurs
INSERT IGNORE INTO tps_gene_molecules (tps_gene_id, molecule_id, relationship_type, confidence, source_reference, notes)
SELECT tg.id, m.id, 'primary_product', 'high', 'Nomenclature TPS - Produit principal', CONCAT('Liaison: ', tg.name, ' → ', m.name)
FROM tps_genes tg, molecules m
WHERE 
  (tg.name LIKE '%Géraniol%' AND m.name IN ('Géraniol', 'Geraniol'))
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Linalol%' AND m.name IN ('Linalol', 'Linalool'))
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Myrcène%' AND m.name IN ('Myrcène', 'Myrcene'))
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Pinène%' AND m.name LIKE '%Pinène%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Caryophyllène%' AND m.name LIKE '%Caryophyllène%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Humulène%' AND m.name LIKE '%Humulène%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Farnesène%' AND m.name LIKE '%Farnesène%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Camphène%' AND m.name LIKE '%Camphène%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Terpinène%' AND m.name LIKE '%Terpinène%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Ocimène%' AND m.name LIKE '%Ocimène%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Sabinène%' AND m.name LIKE '%Sabinène%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Terpinéol%' AND m.name LIKE '%Terpinéol%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Cinéole%' AND m.name LIKE '%Cinéole%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Bornéol%' AND m.name LIKE '%Bornéol%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Camphre%' AND m.name LIKE '%Camphre%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Fenchol%' AND m.name LIKE '%Fenchol%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Thujone%' AND m.name LIKE '%Thujone%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Nerolidol%' AND m.name LIKE '%Nerolidol%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Bisabolol%' AND m.name LIKE '%Bisabolol%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Cadinène%' AND m.name LIKE '%Cadinène%')
